title: Issue of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes and the Book-By Date
content:
Each product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes is issued on its own grounds, only to a customer with an open Summit membership, and carries a book-by date fixed from its issue date.

## Grounds of issue

Each product is issued only from the grounds of issue listed for it:

- **Card-anniversary certificates** are issued within the product's issue period (in calendar days) after the card anniversary, once the card year's purchases reach the product's card purchase requirement.
- **Choice-benefit certificates** are issued when a Summit member of the listed tier makes a companion certificate selection under the Summit loyalty program's choice benefits.
- **Passes** are issued within the product's issue period (in calendar days) after the holder's promotion qualification.

## Who may receive a product

A companion product is issued only to a customer whose Summit membership status is enrolled, active or dormant. The membership status is read from the Summit membership record linked to the product; what the customer says about the membership does not replace that record.

| Summit membership status on record | Companion product may be issued |
|---|---|
| enrolled | yes |
| active | yes |
| dormant | yes |
| closed | no |

## The book-by date

The book-by date is the issue date plus the product's validity in calendar months, keeping the day of the month and falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist.

| Hypothetical issue date | Validity | Book-by date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 12 months | 15 March 2026 |
| 31 August 2023 | 6 months | 29 February 2024 (no 31 February; 2024 is a leap year) |
| 29 February 2024 | 12 months | 28 February 2025 (no 29 February in 2025) |
| 31 May 2025 | 6 months | 30 November 2025 |

## Grant of trips and activation

On issue the product receives the product's number of companion trips in one grant entry and becomes active, at which point it is bookable. A trip grant is booked only on a certificate or pass whose status is issued; a product already active, used, expired or revoked receives no further grant.

## Products that have not yet arrived

A support agent does not issue card-anniversary certificates or passes. A customer whose certificate has not arrived within the product's issue period is transferred to a human representative, while one who asks before that period ends is told when it will arrive.
